Repeatable — several weeks to collect 1000 War Exp (each mission ≈15–30 min)

{npc:Orockle}, in {wiki:Gray Beach|Gray Beach}, leads the fight against Quirefang's {wiki:Hive Born|Hive Born}. You do repeatable missions (blinding antennae, bursting blobs, collecting acid, plugging pores, killing Kollos, breaking crystals) that give experience, War Exp and Favour and help the server open the hive ({wiki:Hive Born World Change|Hive Born World Change}). With enough War Exp you receive the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits|Insectoid Outfits} and addons, and there are 21 achievements to earn in total.
The Hive Born are threatening the world and have to be stopped.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 150+**.
The phase 2 missions and the reward room are only available once the server has advanced the hive to phase 2 or 3.
The items for each mission are given by {npc:Orockle}. If you lose them, you can buy more from him for 150–200 gp each (or borrow them: you do not lose them when you hand in the mission).
it is worth bringing several for the crystals mission
Phase 1: 1 War Exp, 1 Favour and 1000 experience points per mission
Phase 2: 2 War Exp, 2 Favour and 1500 experience points per mission
{wiki:Insectoid Outfits|Insectoid Outfit} (300 War Exp), first addon (500) and second addon (1000)
up to 16 per week in the Hive Cells behind the Hive Gates
Inside the Hive (east structure in phase 2; all structures in phase 3)
Each mission handed in counts as one action against the hive: with **200 actions in a day** (from the whole server) the hive goes up a phase.
Server world change ({wiki:Hive Born World Change}), not a personal access; in phase 3 the hive stays open for 5 days.
Hive Cells behind the Hive Gates (Gooey Mass)
With at least **50 Favour**, buy the pheromone from {npc:Orockle} ({key:reward}, {key:yes}); it only works once the hive has started to open.
The pheromone lasts one week and does not get you through the Hive Gates of the east and west towers; each Hive Cell gives 1 {item:Gooey Mass} per week.

You can accept **all the missions at the same time**. Say {key:mission} to {npc:Orockle} and then the word for each mission: {key:blind}, {key:digestion}, {key:acid}, {key:disable}, {key:kill}, {key:break}.

Each mission handed in counts as one action against the hive. With **200 actions in a day** (from the whole server) the hive moves up a phase and stronger areas open up. In phase 3 the hive stays open for 5 days; on the last day points have to be gathered to go back only to phase 2, otherwise it goes back to phase 1.
Ask any {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC} about the {key:hive} to learn the current phase and how many actions have been done today.
You can see your War Exp, your Favour and how many times you did each mission in the **Quest Log**.
To give up a mission, say {key:quit} and {key:yes} to Orockle. You do not lose your progress, but you can only give up another mission after 30 minutes.

Gray Beach is on the island of {wiki:Quirefang}, which can only be reached through {wiki:Gray Island}. Take a boat to Gray Island from **Ab'Dendriel**, **Venore**, **Darashia** or **Edron** (150 gp): say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} to the captain. On Gray Island go down the **only hole**, **south** of {npc:Scrutinon}. On floor -1 head **northeast** through the underground passage and step into the {item:Water Vortex}. On the other side, use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the ground to go up and head **north** to **Gray Beach**, the small village in the south of the island (depot and temple underground, to the northwest).
Gray Island (the hole leads to Quirefang)
Go to **Gray Beach** and talk to {npc:Orockle}: {key:hi}, {key:fight}, {key:mission}. He lists the missions available in the hive's current phase.
Always available. Each one gives 1 War Exp, 1 Favour and 1000 experience points. To hand in, go back to {npc:Orockle} and talk to him about the mission.
Say {key:blind} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. You receive a {item:Strange Powder (Hive)|Strange Powder}.

Walk around the **east** side of the {wiki:Hive|Hive}, look for small mound-like structures and use the powder on the antennae. You have to use the powder on **8 different antennae**. Then go back to Orockle.
A hive antenna where to use the Strange Powder
Say {key:digestion} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. You receive a {item:Blob Bomb}.

Go to the far **east** of the Hive and, in a small pyramid, go down **2 floors**. Use the {item:Blob Bomb} from a distance (like a rune or a fishing rod) on **7** {item:Floor Blob|Floor Blobs} (patches that move beneath the floor). Then go up the same 2 floors and go back **west** and **south** to Orockle.
Location of the small pyramid at the far east of the Hive
A Floor Blob moving under the floor
Do not destroy more than 7: according to Orockle, the room may fill with digestive acid. The bomb also dissolves after a while.
Say {key:acid} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. You receive 8 {item:Flask of Chitin Dissolver|Flasks of Chitin Dissolver} and a {item:Swarmer Drum}.
Kill 8 {creature:Crawler|Crawlers} and use a {item:Flask of Chitin Dissolver} on each **fresh** corpse. You get {item:Flask of Dissolved Chitin|Flasks of Dissolved Chitin}.

On the hive **surface** (it only works at ground level), use the {item:Swarmer Drum} to call a {creature:Swarmer Hatchling} and use a Flask of Dissolved Chitin on it. The hatchling goes straight to Orockle. Repeat until you have used up the 8 flasks and go back to Orockle.

The drum has a 30-second cooldown. There is no limit to the Flasks of Dissolved Chitin you can make: buy lots of dissolvers and dissolve chitin in bulk. Other players can also call hatchlings for you, which speeds everything up.
Say {key:disable} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. You receive a {item:Gooey Substance}.

Go to the **east** side of the Hive and use the {item:Gooey Substance} on **7** {item:Hive Pore|Hive Pores}. After it is used, the {creature:Lesser Swarmer|Lesser Swarmers} disappear and the pore becomes an {item:Overgrown Hive Pore} for 60 seconds. When you finish you get a message; go back to Orockle.
The pores summon 3 Lesser Swarmers from time to time: be careful not to get cornered.
You can plug the same pore 7 times, but it is faster to use different pores.
Only available when the hive is in phase 2 or 3 ("The defences of the hive are breached"). Each one gives 2 War Exp, 2 Favour and 1500 experience points.

Say {key:kill} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. Kill **9** {creature:Kollos}: they are on the upper floors of the Hive's **east** structure (phase 2) or on all floors, including the ground floor, of the **west** structure (phase 3). Then go back to Orockle.
Say {key:break} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. You receive a {item:Reagent Flask}.

Inside the Hive, kill a {creature:Spidris} and use the {item:Reagent Flask} on the corpse to get {item:Aggressive Fluid}. Use it right away on an {item:Insectoid Monolith} to destroy it. Repeat (a new Spidris corpse for each flask) until you have destroyed **5** monoliths. Then go back to Orockle.
The Aggressive Fluid only lasts a few minutes (about 2). The monoliths recover after 5 minutes.
Bring several {item:Reagent Flask|Reagent Flasks} (buy them or reuse the ones from other times) so you do not have to wait between crystals.
In phase 3 ("The hives defences have fallen") all the structures are open. There are no new missions, but you can keep doing the ones from phases 1 and 2 and enter the reward rooms.

With at least **50 Favour**, say {key:reward} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. The pheromone lasts **one week** and lets you through the {item:Hive Gate|Hive Gates} (except those guarding the east and west towers). You can only collect rewards once the hive has started to open.
Gooey Mass in the Hive Cells

There is a {item:Hive Gate} on each floor of the east structure and the west structure. Behind them are {item:Hive Cell|Hive Cells}: each one can be used **once a week** to get 1 {item:Gooey Mass} (up to 16 per week).
Behind each Hive Gate there are lots of enemies waiting for you.
You do not get stuck behind the Hive Gates: according to {npc:Orockle}, it is always possible to leave those rooms.

The reward room is on the top floor of the Hive's **west** structure; start climbing from this point. There you receive the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits|Insectoid Outfit} and the addons according to your War Exp (see the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits Quest|Insectoid Outfits Quest} guide). To leave, go down the west tower by the same stairs and head **south** to Gray Beach.
War Exp is not consumed: 1000 in total is enough for everything, not 300 + 500 + 1000.

The underground of the **west** tower is very well guarded by {creature:Hive Overseer|Hive Overseers} and is home to the {wiki:Hive Born Bosses|Hive Born Bosses}: {creature:Chopper}, {creature:Fleshslicer}, {creature:Maw}, {creature:Mindmasher}, {creature:Rotspit} and {creature:Shadowstalker}. To leave, go up the same way to the surface of the west tower and head **south** to Gray Beach.

No regular boat docks at Quirefang. From the Hive head back **south** to Gray Beach (depot and temple to restock) and, to leave the island, do the arrival route in reverse: go down to the Gray Beach entrance, south of the village, and return through the cave to {wiki:Gray Island}. There, {npc:Scrutinon} takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore ({key:hi}, the city name and {key:yes}).
This quest is also known as {wiki:Insectoid Outfits Quest|Insectoid Outfits Quest}.
The missions are repeatable: the achievements for each mission count how many times you handed it in (10, 50 and 100 times).
The mission items are not lost when you hand in, so you can lend them to other players.
